mr_title: fix(@angular/ssr): return 302 when redirectTo is a function
mr_description: Ensure the server returns a 302 status code and sets the correct 'Location' header when the redirectTo value is a function, aligning with expected HTTP redirect behavior.

expected_issues.title: Router injected unconditionally during server rendering
expected_issues.description:
renderAngular() now unconditionally injects Router, which throws NullInjectorError for server-rendered applications that do not use @angular/router, breaking SSR for them.

@angular/router is optional for an Angular application. `envInjector.get(Router)` without a not-found value fails when no router providers are registered, so every SSR request of a router-less app now errors. The router must be looked up optionally and redirect/navigation-error handling skipped when absent.
